assign.request: variation trees at /imagine/vary/: scrollbars, background hierarchy, child placement
assign.now: scoping — read requirements + columns.md + prior art
steps: build tone/ lab (up, down, alt, flip, live)

log.msg: found: demo.app()'s mark() only re-marks page.chain() of whatever it is SHOWING, so a nested default-cascade columns tree passed to demo.app(root) never restores default on depth 2/3 after mark() strips it - fixed by passing the deepest child instead (examples/looks/backgrounds does the same, missed it first pass)

found: width:"full" on ANY column - even nested, matching the existing Finder demo at /framework/core/Page/overview/columns/finder/guides/words/full/ - collapses the site's own left sidebar to 0x0. Pre-existing core Page.css behavior, reproduced on the framework's own reference page, out of the public/imagine/vary/** fence - not fixed, logged as a finding
verdict scroll/full: a full-viewport scrollbar reads as an ordinary page scrolling, not a widget bolted onto one
verdict scroll/padded: cramped - two frames nested for one scroll region, content never reaches the column's real width
verdict scroll/flush: reads as part of the column, not a widget dropped into it - no wasted frame, no doubled inset
verdict tone/up: reads as hierarchy - each column sits visibly above the one before it
verdict tone/down: reads as recession not elevation - a well, not a stack; legible but the opposite feeling from stepping up
verdict tone/alt: reads as zebra-striping, not hierarchy - depth 3 matches depth 1
verdict tone/flip: reads as emphasis (you are here), not depth - closer to a modal than a smooth hierarchy
verdict tone/live: one tree, one class swapped on click beats four near-identical page.js files for exploring the same question
verdict place/add: the trail of open columns is its own history, good for drilling in - but four items deep is four columns wide
verdict place/swap: one panel one place, no growing trail - but only one item is ever visible at a time
verdict place/carousel: one item at a time, fully animated, no accumulating trail - good for a small fixed set, wrong the moment two need comparing side by side

headless verify at 400/1920/3440 clean: zero console errors on any of the 15 pages, zero horizontal overflow, no unintended scrollbars outside the scroll lab's own deliberate ones; carousel screenshotted mid-transition + settled, reduced-motion emulated and confirmed transitionDuration 0s with the slide already at its final transform 20ms after click; tone/live control click-swaps schemes with no reload

assign.outcome: **Three variation trees landed at /imagine/vary/** — scroll/ (full-viewport, padded inset bad-pattern, flush bleed), tone/ (stepping up, stepping down, alternating, flip-at-depth, plus a live scheme-switch control), place/ (add-a-column, swap-in-place via ext/tabs, an animated carousel with arrows+dots+reduced-motion). Every lab uses previews() as nav, every variation is a real page ending in a one-line verdict. Headless-verified clean at 400/1920/3440 (zero console errors, zero horizontal overflow); carousel shot mid-transition + settled + under emulated reduced-motion (transitionDuration confirmed 0s, no animation). Two findings logged, not fixed (out of fence): demo.app()'s mark() drops a nested `default` cascade unless handed the deepest page; `width:"full"` collapses the site's own sidebar to 0px, reproduced on the framework's own Finder reference page. Left out: three.js / 3D placement (S-3d's fence) and page-as-config sliders beyond the one tone/live toggle row (owner said cheaply, not exhaustively).
